notes.title: CMANO: NI updates to version 1.13.2!
notes.content:
Hi all, 

CMANO, Northern Inferno, Chains of War and Shifting Sands has been updated to version 1.13.2! 

Check the changelog below! 

1.13.2 Changelog 
- FIXED: Contact-sync for autodetected contacts can lead to positional freeze/flickering 
- FIXED: A-10s will not drop Mk82s in same pass as AGM-65s 
- Includes updated version of "Shamal" scenario (player no longer earns points for destroying runway, since it is not possible) 
- Includes updated version of "Don of a New Era" scenario (fixed airbase munition inventory) 
- Includes updated version of "Pole Positions" scenario (fixed AI mission activation issue)

notes.title: Version 1.12.3 now available!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Version 1.12.3 is now available for CMANO, Northern Inferno and Chains of War!

1.12.3 changelog

* FIXED: #11702: Kh-31P Missile DLZ logic 
* FIXED: #11684: Cargo cloning issue 
* FIXED: #11701: Units on AAW patrol not tailing 'unfriendly' contacts. 
* Various tweaks to UI to make paradrop-capable units more apparent. 
* The Database viewer now lists cargo information on a per-loadout basis.
* Fixed issue with manually changing aircraft altitude over land

notes.title: Update 1.12.2 is now available!
notes.content:
Hi all, 

Update 1.12.2 is now available for CMANO, Northern Inferno and Chains of War! 

1.12.2 changelog:
* FIXED: Unit may not go out of comms if all onboard comm devices are destroyed. 
* FIXED: Excessive delay in opening DB viewer. 
* FIXED: When resuming from campaign checkpoint-save, it was possible to play only in "standalone" mode, not "campaign" mode 
* FIXED: Aircraft holding on landing queue being reset to RTB status (thus not completing landing). 
* FIXED: Loitering weapons (e.g. TALD decoys) may stay up indefinitely if the loiter fuel consumption value is 0 
* Aircraft damage points are now visible on DB viewer 
* Various tweaks on simulation performance and UI responsiveness in heavy scenarios.
* Fixed the size problem with the "New Mission" window (no longer necessary to delete Command.ini to reset it) 
* Fixed the "I accidentally added a railgun/laser/Tac-EMP weapon/platform to a scenario [prior to v1.12], and now I get blocked from loading it because I don't have a CoW license" problem.

notes.title: Version 1.092 is now available!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We just made a new version available, which contains a number of fixes and a couple of tweaks. As always, we will continue to work in order to further refine the game and are counting on your feedback! 

Thanks all and have fun!

v1.092

FIXED: Target speed not modifying PH significantly in guided AAW weapons 
FIXED: Salvo-fire backwards compatibility bug 
FIXED: Problems with SM-3 against IRBM 
TWEAK: Contact Report window gives better contact description depending on ID status 
TWEAK: Give focus to formation editor window if it is visible when selecting one of group members 
FIXED: #10085: ASBM Issues: Loss of target and ASBM warheads circle 
TWEAK: All ballistic missiles and RVs have the BOL flag (ie. can be fired at coordinates) 
Fixed: Unregistered DB was assumed to be CWDB-class (showed wrong platform pic) 
FIXED: [B763] Strange MiG-31 Intercept behavior 
FIXED: Subs ignore patrol transit/station depth overrides 
FIXED: Null-reference crash on Lua GetScenarioTitle 
TWEAK: Tweaks on satellite-prediction form 
FIXED: Incorrect pre-deletion check for in-use for EE triggers, conditions and actions 
FIXED: Unable to classify very quiet sonar contacts 
FIXED: SA-12 does not detect ballistic targets 
FIXED: NI#8 erroneous scoring action
FIXED: Spanish marines with superbinoculars 
FIXED: #10036: [B757.3] Blank Scenario Database update crash bug 
FIXED: NI#14 crash at start 
FIXED: #6795: [B492] Aircraft Decelarating instantly

notes.title: 1.09 Hotfix is now available
notes.content:
A hotfix for the steam version of Command: Modern Air/Naval Operations and Command: Northern Inferno is now available. This hotfix should fix the license issues some people were experiencing and will get everyone access to the content they have bought a license for.

The patch will be updated automatically by the Steam client. If that is not the case, please try and restart your client.

We would like to thank those who downloaded the beta patch and helped us test it. You can now opt out of the beta program again in the same way you opted in. Just select the “None – Opt out of betas” option.

If you are facing any more issues after installing this patch, please let us know and describe the circumstances in which the bug occurred as detailed as possible.

Thank you for your support.

Surtur

notes.title: 1.09 Beta Patch is now available
notes.content:
As some of you are facing issues with the license checks for Command: Modern Air/Naval Operations and Command: Northern Inferno, we have created a beta patch that we hope may fix the issues. 

We’re not sure why it is happening but we swapped the order 2 lines of code are executed and we think this may help. It might sounds silly but we suspect this order is what’s causing the issue but as we can’t repeat it here we can’t be sure and need your help to validate it. 

We need as many people as possible to try this patch. Even if the game was working before, we need to know it’s still working! It works fine for us, but it did before too so we can’t validate its fixed. 

To get the beta patch follow these instructions. It’s very simple to do so don’t worry if you are not technical! Here are step by step instructions. 

- Go to your steam games library in the steam client

- Right click on the game - Command (NI or CMANO, whichever you use) and select properties
Note the tabs across the top – select the beta tab

- From the drop down list of betas select the "Beta"

This will queue the beta update (its very small only a few MB so will be quick once it starts)
In your game library the name of the game will have (Public Beta) appended to it to show you have the beta version. 

If the download does not start you may have to exit steam and reload it to force it. 

You can also sometimes force it by going to the list of downloads and forcing the update to apply. 

Whenever you want to opt out of the beta follow the instructions above, and from the drop down list just select None – opt out of betas. 

Please let us know if this beta patch fixes your issues and we will make it public. If your problems are not addressed, please let us know (in as much detail as possible!) what error messages you are getting and what you were trying to do at this point. 

We are sorry for the issues introduced with this patch and we are dedicated to bringing a fix to everyone who is experiencing the licensing issues.

Thanks for your help in resolving this – we really appreciate it!

The Slitherine & Warfaresims Teams

- Surtur
